candidates.label: ParentAudience
candidates.comment: A ParentAudience, as a PeopleAudience, describes characteristics of parents who might be interested in certain content. Also called parental demographic, parent group, family audience. Examples: 'parents of young children', 'parents of teenagers', 'expectant parents'. Distinct from PeopleAudience, which is a broader category for any group of people.

candidates.label: LikeAction
candidates.comment: A LikeAction is a react action representing the act of expressing a positive sentiment about an object. Also called approve action, endorse action, favorite action. Examples: liking a post on social media, giving a thumbs-up to a video, expressing approval for an idea. Distinct from DislikeAction, which expresses negative sentiment.

types.embedding_query_text: Opinion: A view or judgment formed about something, not necessarily based on fact or knowledge. Also called View, Belief, Stance. Examples: The right man for her is whoever she chooses.

chosen_type.label: Opinion
chosen_type.definition: A view or judgment formed about something, not necessarily based on fact or knowledge.
chosen_type.justification: No existing candidate directly represents 'Opinion' as a general concept; a new type is needed.

mentions: The right man for her is whoever she chooses

candidates.label: OpinionNewsArticle
candidates.comment: An OpinionNewsArticle, as a NewsArticle, primarily expresses opinions rather than journalistic reporting of news and events. Also called opinion piece, editorial, column. Examples: an editorial in a newspaper, a political commentary, a personal essay in the opinion section. Distinct from Report, which presents factual findings.

candidates.label: Claim
candidates.comment: A specific, factually-oriented statement that can be reviewed for accuracy. Also called assertion, statement, proposition, contention. Examples: "The Earth is flat," "Coffee cures cancer," "This product is 100% organic." Distinct from ClaimReview, which is the review of a claim.

candidates.label: Comment
candidates.comment: A textual remark or observation made about an item, such as a blog post. Also called remark, feedback, note, annotation. Examples: A user's comment on a YouTube video, a review on a product page, a blog post comment, a code comment.

candidates.label: DisagreeAction
candidates.comment: A react action expressing a negative opinion or difference of opinion regarding an object, proposition, or theme. Also called Express disagreement, object to, dispute, dissent. Examples: Disagreeing with a political statement, objecting to a proposed plan, disputing a fact. Distinct from AgreeAction, which expresses positive sentiment or agreement.

candidates.label: ClaimReview
candidates.comment: A creative work that provides a fact-checking review of a specific claim. Also called fact-check, debunking, truth verification. Examples: A Snopes article debunking a viral claim, a PolitiFact rating of a politician's statement. Distinct from Review, which is a general assessment of an item.

types.embedding_query_text: MediaContent: Information or entertainment delivered through media channels. Also called Content, Media material, Broadcast. Examples: live feed.

chosen_type.label: WebContent
chosen_type.justification: schema.org/WebContent is the best fit for 'MediaContent' like a 'live feed', as it represents content accessible via the web.

candidates.label: WebContent
candidates.comment: A general type representing any content accessible via the web, including web pages, websites, and their elements. Also called web content item, online content, digital web asset. Examples: a blog post, an entire website, an image embedded on a page.

candidates.label: HealthTopicContent
candidates.comment: HealthTopicContent is web content about a specific aspect of a health topic, such as a medical condition, its symptoms, or treatments. Also called medical web content, health information article, wellness resource. Examples: an article explaining diabetes symptoms, a webpage detailing cancer treatments, a video on heart disease prevention.

candidates.label: AdvertiserContentArticle
candidates.comment: An AdvertiserContentArticle is an Article that has been paid for or produced to the specifications of an external entity. Also called sponsored article, advertorial, native advertising, paid content. Examples: A blog post promoting a product written by an influencer, a sponsored news segment, an article funded by a brand. Distinct from NewsArticle, which is typically produced by independent journalists.

candidates.label: BroadcastEvent
candidates.comment: A BroadcastEvent is a PublicationEvent representing an event that is transmitted over the air or online. Also called live broadcast, streamed event, televised event, radio broadcast. Examples: a live news report, a sports game broadcast, a concert livestream.

candidates.label: BroadcastService
candidates.comment: A BroadcastService is a Service that delivers content via broadcast, either over the air or online. Also called broadcasting service, media transmission service, content delivery service. Examples: a national television network, a satellite radio provider, an internet radio service.
